title: Rope Bridge
description: Simulate a rope with 2 and 10 knots, tracking tail positions.
writeup:
## Approach

Model the rope as a list of knot positions. After moving the head, each subsequent knot follows its predecessor using a simple rule: if the gap exceeds 1 in any axis, move one step toward the predecessor (diagonally if needed). Track positions visited by the last knot in a set.

## Part 1

Simulate a 2-knot rope (head + tail). Count distinct tail positions.

## Part 2

Simulate a 10-knot rope. The same following logic applies to each consecutive knot pair. The tail (knot 9) visits fewer positions because movements dampen through the chain.
